nodes.title: Shortcast — Project README
nodes.summary: Project overview documenting Shortcast, a macOS 15+ SwiftUI app that converts long videos into ready-to-post shorts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Covers architecture (WhisperKit transcription → Director LLM → AVFoundation cutting → vertical reframe → publish via Upload-Post or TikTok official API), installation, build-from-source instructions with XcodeGen, model choices (Gemma 4 12B, Qwen 3.5 9B, Gemma 4 E4B), the full processing pipeline diagram, privacy guarantees, known limitations, and acknowledgements. Licensed Apache 2.0.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with embedded ASCII diagrams, code blocks, and HTML badges.
nodes.name: README.md

nodes.title: TikTok Official Publishing Integration
nodes.summary: Technical design document for Shortcast's TikTok official Content Posting API integration. Documents the current manual-token flow (inbox upload via video.upload scope and direct post via video.publish scope), the app settings stored in AppSettings (client key, secret, access token, publish mode, privacy, duet/stitch/comment toggles, AIGC label), the publish behavior (single-chunk upload, inbox vs direct post initialization payloads), known limitations (no OAuth, no refresh tokens, no scheduling for TikTok official), next integration steps (OAuth callback, token refresh, creator-info query, chunked upload), and the PublishingProvider extension pattern for future providers.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with Swift code snippets showing the PublishingProvider protocol pattern and JSON API payloads.
nodes.name: docs/tiktok-official-publishing.md

nodes.title: YouTube & Instagram Official Publishing — Implementation Ideas
nodes.summary: Detailed implementation plan for adding YouTube Data API v3 and Instagram Graph API official publishing providers. Covers the provider-per-platform architecture pattern (vs unified Upload-Post), YouTube resumable upload protocol with chunked upload strategy, Instagram two-step container creation + publish with resumable upload for the hosting challenge, authentication flows (manual token vs in-app OAuth via ASWebAuthenticationSession), Shorts/Reels detection logic, per-platform settings design (YouTube: client key/secret/access/refresh tokens/channel ID; Instagram: access token/user ID/page ID), a unified settings UI with per-platform provider selection, an implementation roadmap (Phase 1 YouTube week 1-2, Phase 2 Instagram week 3-4, Phase 3 multi-provider mix week 5), and key challenges (Instagram video hosting, OAuth token management, rate limits, scheduling complexity, error handling).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with Swift sketches, ASCII diagrams, API specifications, and phased implementation roadmap.
nodes.name: docs/youtube-instagram-publishing-ideas.md

layers.name: App Entry & Bootstrap
layers.description: SwiftUI application entry point and environment setup. ShortcastApp bootstraps the three core @Observable objects (AppSettings, ModelManager, WorkspaceModel) and injects them into the SwiftUI environment via .environment().

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.description: All SwiftUI views implementing the macOS UI. ContentView is the root state-machine view that routes between DropZoneView, ProcessingView, ResultsView (single-video flow) and ShortsProgressView, ShortsResultsView (long-video flow). SettingsView provides configuration. Views observe @Observable models from the layers below and call into WorkspaceModel to trigger actions.

layers.name: State Orchestration
layers.description: Central state management layer. WorkspaceModel is the main state machine implementing the two-flow pipeline (single-video captioning and long-video shorts). It orchestrates all service calls: transcription, moment finding, captioning, cutting, reframing, and publishing. ShortClip is an @Observable per-clip lifecycle model combining candidate + cut clip + editable captions + publish state.

layers.name: ML Inference & AI Services
layers.description: On-device machine learning layer using MLX and Gemma4Swift. ModelManager handles model lifecycle (download, load, engine management). GemmaService orchestrates multimodal generation (video+audio→JSON captions). MomentFinderService uses Director LLM to find viral moments from transcripts. TranscriptionService wraps WhisperKit for on-device speech-to-text. MimoService provides an optional remote LLM alternative. ChatModelProfile defines per-model sampling configuration.

layers.name: Media Processing Pipeline
layers.description: AVFoundation-based video and audio processing services. MediaExtractor handles video validation, audio extraction, and clip cutting. VerticalReframer converts 16:9 to 9:16 using Vision face tracking with a panning virtual camera and blurred letterbox fallback. VideoOverlayRenderer burns text hooks into clips using AVVideoCompositionCoreAnimationTool.

layers.name: Publishing Integration
layers.description: Protocol-based multi-platform publishing abstraction. PublishingProvider defines the protocol; UploadPostProvider and TikTokOfficialProvider are concrete implementations. UploadPostClient handles the Upload-Post REST API (multipart form, all 3 platforms). TikTokOfficialProvider handles the TikTok Content Posting API (inbox upload or direct post with chunked upload).

layers.name: Data Models
layers.description: Pure value types and data structures representing the domain model. All models conform to Sendable for concurrency safety. AppSettings is the centralized user configuration persisted to UserDefaults. The remaining models represent pipeline artifacts: VideoJob (input metadata), ClipCandidate (Director-selected moments), PostVariant (platform-specific post content), and PublishReport (publish outcomes).

layers.name: Configuration & Resources
layers.description: App configuration files, bundled resources, UI assets, and documentation. Includes the KeychainStore utility for secure credential storage, the bundled AI prompt document (social-content-coach.md), Xcode asset catalog assets, and project-level documentation.

layers.name: Developer Tools & Build Pipeline
layers.description: Developer-facing tools and CI/CD infrastructure. Probe is a CLI tool that runs the full generation pipeline headlessly for testing. The GitHub Actions workflow builds, packages, and releases the app as a .dmg. project.yml defines the XcodeGen project with all SPM dependencies.

tour.title: App Entry & Environment Bootstrap
tour.description: Shortcast is a macOS SwiftUI app using the @Observable pattern. The entry point `ShortcastApp.swift` creates three core objects — AppSettings (user prefs), ModelManager (ML models), and WorkspaceModel (pipeline orchestrator) — and injects them into the SwiftUI environment. This is the foundation every other layer builds on.

tour.title: The View Router — ContentView
tour.description: ContentView is the root view and serves as a state machine. It observes the ModelManager (is the model ready?) and WorkspaceModel (what phase are we in?) to decide which screen to show. This pattern keeps navigation logic centralized and deterministic.

tour.title: The Pipeline Orchestrator — WorkspaceModel
tour.description: WorkspaceModel is the central state machine that orchestrates the entire processing pipeline. For the long-video flow, it sequences: video validation → audio extraction → transcription → moment finding → clip cutting → captioning → vertical reframing → publishing. For the single-video flow, it runs a shorter pipeline: video → multimodal captioning → post variants. It calls into every service layer.

tour.title: On-Device ML Inference
tour.description: All AI processing happens locally on the Mac — no cloud ML calls. ModelManager handles model lifecycle (download from HuggingFace, load into MLX engines). Three ML services use these engines: TranscriptionService (WhisperKit for speech-to-text), MomentFinderService (Director LLM — Qwen 3.5 9B or Gemma 4 12B for finding viral moments from transcripts), and GemmaService (Gemma 4 E4B multimodal for generating captions from video+audio). PromptBuilder assembles prompts from a bundled copywriter document.

tour.title: Media Processing Pipeline
tour.description: Three services handle all video/audio manipulation: MediaExtractor (validate videos, extract audio to .m4a, cut clips with passthrough export), VerticalReframer (convert 16:9 to 9:16 using Vision face tracking with a panning virtual camera, or blurred letterbox fallback), and VideoOverlayRenderer (burn text hooks into clips as top bands with fade-out animations).

tour.title: Multi-Platform Publishing
tour.description: Publishing uses a protocol-based abstraction: PublishingProvider defines the interface, with two concrete implementations — UploadPostProvider (sends to all 3 platforms via Upload-Post REST API in one request) and TikTokOfficialProvider (uses TikTok's Content Posting API directly with inbox upload or direct post). The protocol pattern makes it easy to add new providers (YouTube/Instagram official APIs are planned in docs).

tour.title: Data Models & Domain Types
tour.description: All models are Sendable for concurrency safety. AppSettings persists user preferences to UserDefaults. The pipeline flows through: VideoJob (input) → ClipCandidate (Director-selected moments) → PostVariant (platform-specific posts) → PublishReport (publish outcomes). ShortClip is the observable per-clip lifecycle wrapper combining all these.

tour.title: Configuration, Resources & Dev Tools
tour.description: The project uses XcodeGen (project.yml) to generate the Xcode project from YAML, with SPM dependencies on Gemma4Swift, mlx-swift-lm, HuggingFace Hub, and WhisperKit. The bundled social-content-coach.md is the AI copywriter prompt loaded at runtime. Probe/main.swift is a CLI tool that runs the full generation pipeline headlessly for testing without the UI. CI/CD is handled by GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/release.yml).
